correctness.rationale: Exhaustive dichotomy from Bezout 3a+2b=18 gives a=0,2,4. Case 0 violates four pure-quad incidences (16 needed, at most15). Case 2 forces two extra lines to share at least two distinct triple points. Case 4 forces 9-line (t2,t3)=(3,11), yielding a 3x3 net whose three transversal lines are both concurrent and pairwise meeting at three nodes; the affine-map lemma is proved explicitly in RESULT.md. All hypotheses and boundaries are stated.
